subject: general
question: Where were the World Rowing Championships 2025 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shanghai, China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 53rd World Rowing Championships 2025 were held in Shanghai, China, from 21 to 28 September 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shanghai hosted the 2025 edition at the Shanghai Water Sports Centre on Dianshan Lake.**
 
• **This venue was originally selected for the 2021 championships, which were cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic.**
 
• **The event was organised by the International Federation of Rowing Societies (FISA) and the Chinese Rowing Federation.**
 
• **The championship marked the 53rd edition of the global rowing event.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Medal Table (Top Nations)**__

 __
 
• Netherlands: 4 Gold, 1 Silver, 1 Bronze (Total 6)
 
• Great Britain: 3 Gold, 4 Silver, 1 Bronze (Total 8)
 
• China: 3 Gold, 3 Silver, 1 Bronze (Total 7)
 
 
 
• **Event Background**__
 __
 
• The 2021 event scheduled in Shanghai was cancelled due to the pandemic.
 
• The 2025 event utilised the same planned venue, restoring the city’s long-awaited hosting opportunity.
 
 
 
• **Organising Bodies**__
 __
 
• FISA: International governing body for rowing.
 
• Chinese Rowing Federation: National authority supporting the event.
 
 
 
• **Venue Highlight**__
 
 
• Dianshan Lake: A premier water sports location in Shanghai.
 
• Equipped for international rowing standards.
